subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He graduated the govt. school of Art in Kolkata. (b) He is recognized as the most valuable painter of Bangladesh. (c) He died of lungs cancer. (d) Zainul Abedin was born in 1914 in Kishoreganj. (e) Still now he is referred with great respect as Shilpacharya in Bangladesh. (f) He is also the pioneer of Bangladeshi modern art. (g) He was also appointed as a teacher there. (h) He is highly admired for his 'Bengal Famine Sketches'.  Part B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
